scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to exactly two consecutive deletions on binary weight-two inputs; not arbitrary two deletions, not variable burst length, and not other input compositions. The mathematical proof is all-length; finite enumeration is corroboration. Unlocated equivalent literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact sparse-marker capacity for one adjacent two-deletion burst
